entries.rationale: Vulnerable 1.x is reachable only through minimatch in lint and type-analysis tooling; no untrusted pattern reaches a released service. Upgrade is tracked until the parent tools accept the patched line.
Vulnerable 5.x copies are nested under TypeScript and ESLint tooling and are not present in an application runtime path.
The vulnerable copies are nested under ESLint, cosmiconfig and build-time XML tooling; production API YAML parsing uses the patched yaml package instead.
The vulnerable copy belongs to the MCP dependency bundled by the shadcn design tool. The API resolves patched Hono 4.13.x and does not import this nested server.
The vulnerable copies are used by AJV inside shadcn MCP/build tooling; they do not validate URLs in the released API or web server.
PostCSS runs only while compiling repository-controlled CSS. Customer content and runtime requests cannot supply source maps to this compiler.
The vulnerable copy is nested under the shadcn MCP development dependency; the released services do not use it for SSRF or trust-boundary decisions.
Only PostCSS build tooling retains nanoid 3.x. Runtime API and database code resolve patched nanoid 5.1.16 and never pass attacker-controlled sizes.
